subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this opt-in grouped-Claw manifest and read-only planner as a core experimental contract, with later lifecycle ownership decisions continuing in the stacked PRs?
rationale: The remaining question is not a mechanical defect: it determines whether a new core CLI, manifest schema, environment gate, and multi-stage lifecycle stack are the intended product architecture.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental core slice
options.body: Accept the opt-in read-only planner as the foundation and continue review of later mutation slices under the same explicit ownership contract.

options.title: Pause for RFC ownership decision
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until RFC owners decide the permanent core-versus-extension boundary and install identity model.

options.title: Route the concept outside core
options.body: Decline the new core command and direct the packaging workflow toward an external plugin or ClawHub-based implementation if existing seams are sufficient.

recommendation.title: Pause for RFC ownership decision
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until RFC owners decide the permanent core-versus-extension boundary and install identity model.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review directly addresses the intended product boundary and the remaining lifecycle identity question.
